title: Manual server digest generation can be submitted repeatedly while the previous job is still running
reasoning: For Ghostwriter generation, isGenerating is cleared as soon as the trigger request returns, while the status polling task continues until the server job completes. The Generate button is disabled only by isGenerating/localDigestService/isSyncing, so it becomes tappable again during the active server job. Tapping again cancels only the local polling task and triggers another server digest, potentially creating duplicate manual digests.
reproduction: Enable Ghostwriter, tap Generate Digest Now, wait for the trigger request to return but before status is complete, then tap Generate Digest Now again. A second triggerDigest request is sent while the first server job is still running.
recommendation: Keep an explicit serverGenerationInProgress state true until pollGhostwriterStatus reaches a terminal state, and include it in the button disabled condition. Alternatively disable while ghostwriterStatusTask is active and cancel it on view disappearance.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: There are no SettingsView tests for manual Ghostwriter generation state transitions; App/Tests/EpilogueTests.swift only asserts true.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a UI/view-model test with a triggerDigest mock that returns an id and a delayed non-complete status, then assert a second tap cannot call triggerDigest again until completion or failure.
minimumFixScope: App/Sources/Views/SettingsView.swift generation state management and button disabled condition.
